images.alt:
Snapshot from Apple dev vide, showing a regular iPhone side-by-side with a folded iPhone Duo.

On the regular iPhone, the top toolbar contains a few buttons: a back arrow button, a dot-dot-dot button, and a button that says “Select”.

On the iPhone Duo, the back and dot-dot buttons are in a toolbar placed vertically along the right edge, but the Select button is still in an area along the top edge.

record.text:
In the Duo dev video, they describe how text buttons can't be moved to the new vertical sidebar, as opposed to icon buttons.

I wonder if that's one of the reasons Liquid Glass pushed hard for icon buttons, even though these are harder to understand; they make the vertical layout possible at all.
